<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Amr &amp; Yasmine — Engagement Ceremony</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy: #1c3c5a;
    --navy-deep: #12283e;
    --gold: #b98f52;
    --card-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
    --ink-soft: #3c5670;
    --sea-1: #dcebf1;
    --sea-2: #b8d4e2;
  }

  *{ box-sizing:border-box; }
  html{ scroll-behavior:smooth; }

  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    color:var(--navy);
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,45,68,0.05) 0%, rgba(20,45,68,0.35) 85%, rgba(20,45,68,0.55) 100%),
      url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center top;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-attachment: fixed;
    min-height:100vh;
  }

  .scene{
    width:100%;
    min-height:100vh;
    padding:36px 16px 40px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
  }

  /* ---------- Top spacer so panels start below the fold, over the photo ---------- */
  .hero-spacer{
    width:100%;
    max-width:460px;
    height:78vh;
    min-height:420px;
  }

  .hero-caption{
    text-align:center;
    margin-top:0;
    padding:14px 18px;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
    display:inline-block;
    font-family:'Cinzel', serif;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:3px;
    color:var(--navy);
  }
  .caption-wrap{
    width:100%;
    max-width:460px;
    text-align:center;
    margin:-40px auto 0;
  }

  /* ---------- Sections below the photo ---------- */
  .sections{
    width:100%;
    max-width:460px;
    margin-top:28px;
  }

  .panel{
    background:var(--card-bg);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    border-radius:22px;
    padding:28px 26px 30px;
    margin-bottom:22px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 40px -18px rgba(15,40,60,0.3);
  }

  .panel-title{
    font-family:'Cinzel', serif;
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:3.5px;
    color:var(--navy);
    text-align:center;
    margin:0 0 4px;
  }
  .panel-sub{
    text-align:center;
    font-size:15px;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    margin:0 0 18px;
  }

  .map-frame{
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:16/11;
    border:0;
    border-radius:14px;
    display:block;
    filter:saturate(0.9);
  }
  .map-link{
    display:block;
    text-align:center;
    margin-top:14px;
    font-size:16px;
    color:var(--navy);
    text-decoration:none;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold);
    width:fit-content;
    margin-left:auto;
    margin-right:auto;
    padding-bottom:2px;
    letter-spacing:0.5px;
  }

  form{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; }
  .field{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; text-align:left; }
  .field label{
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:1.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--navy-deep);
    font-family:'Cinzel', serif;
    font-weight:500;
  }
  .field input{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size:18px;
    padding:12px 14px;
    border-radius:10px;
    border:1px solid rgba(28,60,90,0.25);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    color:var(--navy-deep);
    outline:none;
    transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
  }
  .field input::placeholder{ color:#8ba1b4; }
  .field input:focus{
    border-color:var(--gold);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(185,143,82,0.18);
  }
  .field small{ color:#7d93a6; font-size:13px; }

  .submit-btn{
    margin-top:6px;
    padding:14px 20px;
    border:none;
    border-radius:12px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy), var(--navy-deep));
    color:#f4ead9;
    font-family:'Cinzel', serif;
    font-size:15px;
    letter-spacing:2px;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, opacity .15s;
    box-shadow:0 12px 22px -10px rgba(18,40,62,0.6);
  }
  .submit-btn:hover{ transform:translateY(-2px); }
  .submit-btn:active{ transform:translateY(0); }
  .submit-btn:disabled{ opacity:0.6; cursor:default; transform:none; }

  .confirm{
    display:none;
    text-align:center;
    padding:16px;
    border-radius:12px;
    background:rgba(28,60,90,0.06);
    border:1px dashed var(--gold);
    color:var(--navy-deep);
    font-size:16px;
    margin-top:4px;
  }
  .confirm.show{ display:block; animation:fadein .4s ease; }
  @keyframes fadein{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);} }

  footer{
    text-align:center;
    font-size:14px;
    color:rgba(28,60,90,0.6);
    letter-spacing:1px;
    margin:6px 0 20px;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{ scroll-behavior:auto; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="scene">

  <!-- ===================== BACKGROUND PHOTO SPACER ===================== -->
  <div class="hero-spacer"></div>
  <div class="caption-wrap">
    <div class="hero-caption">ENGAGEMENT CEREMONY · 11.09.2026</div>
  </div>
  <!-- =================== END BACKGROUND PHOTO SPACER =================== -->

  <div class="sections">

    <div class="panel">
      <div class="panel-title">FIND US</div>
      <div class="panel-sub">Hotel El Anfoushi · Al Fayrouz Hall · Bahary, Alexandria</div>
      <iframe
        class="map-frame"
        src="https://www.google.com/maps?q=Hotel+El+Anfoushi+Bahary+Alexandria+Egypt&output=embed"
        loading="lazy"
        referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"
        title="Hotel El Anfoushi location map">
      </iframe>
      <a class="map-link" href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+El+Anfoushi+Bahary+Alexandria+Egypt" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in Google Maps →</a>
    </div>

    <div class="panel">
      <div class="panel-title">RSVP</div>
      <div class="panel-sub">Kindly confirm your attendance below</div>

      <form id="rsvpForm">
        <div class="field">
          <label for="fullName">Name</label>
          <input type="text" id="fullName" name="fullName" placeholder="Your full name" required>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="phone">Phone Number</label>
          <input type="tel" id="phone" name="phone" placeholder="e.g. 01xxxxxxxxx" pattern="[0-9+\s]{7,15}" required>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="companions">Number of Companions</label>
          <input type="number" id="companions" name="companions" min="0" max="20" placeholder="0" value="0" required>
          <small>Excluding you</small>
        </div>
        <button type="submit" class="submit-btn" id="submitBtn">CONFIRM ATTENDANCE</button>
      </form>

      <div class="confirm" id="confirmMsg"></div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <footer>Amr &amp; Yasmine · 11 September 2026 · Alexandria</footer>

</div>

<script>
  const form = document.getElementById('rsvpForm');
  const confirmMsg = document.getElementById('confirmMsg');
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  const submissions = [];

  form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const name = document.getElementById('fullName').value.trim();
    const phone = document.getElementById('phone').value.trim();
    const companions = document.getElementById('companions').value;

    submissions.push({ name, phone, companions, at: new Date().toISOString() });

    const total = Number(companions) + 1;
    confirmMsg.textContent = `Thank you, ${name}! We've noted your RSVP for ${total} guest${total > 1 ? 's' : ''}.`;
    confirmMsg.classList.add('show');

    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.textContent = 'ATTENDANCE CONFIRMED';
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>
